snippet.title: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Set sail with the Straw Hat Crew on a new voyage of flavor!  🌊

ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet arrives October 23, 2026 on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, App Store, and Google Play.

Pre-order now on Steam: https://bnent.eu/OnePiece-GrandGourmet
